authorizationEvidence.questionAsked: GA에 방문자가 거의 안 잡히는 원인은 연결 오류가 아닙니다. 사이트가 '더보기 → 선택적 이용 통계'를 직접 켠 방문자만 GA에 보내도록 만들어져 있습니다(옵트인, 10/13 승인 기록 기준). 그래서 28일 동안 3명만 잡혔습니다. 방문자 집계 방식을 어떻게 바꿀까요?
authorizationEvidence.choiceDescriptionShownToOwner: 모든 방문자를 GA로 집계합니다(광고 차단기 사용자 제외). 더보기에서 언제든 끌 수 있고, 개인정보처리방침에 GA 사용 고지를 추가합니다. 유럽 시간대 방문자는 GDPR 때문에 지금처럼 직접 켜야 집계합니다. 검색어·개인 입력·광고 추적 제외는 그대로입니다.

supersedes: The consent default recorded as preserved in docs/approvals/ga4-pageviews-20261013.json ("consent defaults": off until the visitor opts in on 더보기). Everything else there (manual page_view, safe route vocabulary, ads denied, Enhanced Measurement disabled requirement) stays.
cause: lib/personal-analytics.ts loads the Google tag only after setAnalyticsConsent(true); before this change app/analytics-consent.tsx returned enabled only for a stored 'true' or a legacy personal-briefing true, so a visitor who never opened 더보기 sent nothing. The 2026-10-13 passive review (docs/reviews/ga4-public-passive-20261013.json) already showed consentNotGranted on a fresh visit.

change.lib/analytics-default.ts: new: on by default; off until chosen for EU/EEA, UK and Swiss time zones (Europe/*, Atlantic EU islands, Cyprus, Ceuta, French overseas departments), an unreadable time zone, Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track
change.app/analytics-consent.tsx: useAnalyticsConsent: a stored choice on 더보기 wins, then the legacy personal-briefing answer, then the browser default; the notice under the checkbox now says it is on by default and that Europe must turn it on (4 languages; the Korean text avoids a syllable outside the bundled font subset)
change.scripts/ga4-browser-probe.ts: the manual production probe now visits as two Seoul-time profiles (on by default: first page, 더보기 with the box ticked, moves, reload, withdrawal, reload after withdrawal) and one Berlin-time profile (nothing before a choice, then the checkbox, moves, reload, withdrawal); requirements R2a/R2/R3/R4/R5 follow
change..github/workflows/analytics-check.yml: header comment describes the two kinds of visit

unchanged: the tag is still loaded only through setAnalyticsConsent(true) in lib/personal-analytics.ts
send_page_view false, manual page_view for the closed public route vocabulary only, page_title KORETAIL, empty referrer, no query or fragment
ad_storage, ad_user_data and ad_personalization denied; Google signals and ad personalization signals off
the 더보기 checkbox, its label and its withdrawal behaviour; a stored 'false' stops everything at once and after reload
